note: Maps platform detections to DPDPA controls. Code-scan findings use key code.sink.<sinkType>.

rules.title: Personal data written to logs
rules.remediation: Remove or mask personal data before logging; add a redaction layer to the logger.

rules.title: Personal data sent to an AI/LLM provider
rules.remediation: Minimise or pseudonymise before prompting; ensure a processor contract and record the provider (and its country) in the ROPA.

rules.title: Personal data shared with a third-party service
rules.remediation: Confirm a processor contract and lawful basis; record the recipient in the ROPA.

rules.title: Personal data sent to analytics
rules.remediation: Collect consent before analytics; exclude child users from tracking.

rules.title: Personal data in cookies or browser storage
rules.remediation: Avoid storing personal data client-side; set secure cookie flags.

rules.title: Personal data sent to an external API
rules.remediation: Use TLS and record the recipient.

rules.title: Personal data stored in a database
rules.remediation: Ensure encryption at rest, access control and a retention rule.

rules.title: Personal data written to files or object storage
rules.remediation: Encrypt, restrict access and apply retention.

rules.title: Personal data flows to an unclassified sink
rules.remediation: Review the flow and classify the destination.
